items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: when I first started to work with him

ctx.x: Oaken had four strings. Yeah, yeah. Oaken, Oaken, Oaken, Oaken, Oaken. See, but Billy had three. Billy Marrera on him. Billy had three, three and four. Billy's the first string, you never put them on. Oh, Martin. I look. I look like, he looked to you with your first look at him. Like he's a selfish kind of a guy, but he's not. Because I thought that when I first started to work with him, you know. Is that going? That's all right.
He looked like he would be a selfish kind of a guy with him.
